title: C++: Inheritance
description: Demonstrate inheritance with a base Animal class and derived Dog and Cat classes with virtual methods.

steps.title: Animal Hierarchy
steps.description: Define a base `Animal` class with `virtual void speak() = 0`. Derive `Dog` (speak prints 'Woof!') and `Cat` (speak prints 'Meow!'). Create a Dog and Cat, call speak on both via Animal pointers.
hints: virtual void speak() = 0; makes it abstract.
Use Animal* ptr = new Dog(); ptr->speak();

verification.failureMessage: Call speak() on both Dog and Cat
